source.projection_note: This public snapshot is a bounded projection of private Lab research-control data. The Lab artifacts remain authoritative.

readiness_scale.2: named architecture or substantial source material
readiness_scale.3: paper-shaped draft ready for focused related-work and claim-control

candidates.title: Second-Order Scientific Method: Representation Construction as an Object of Inquiry
candidates.claim_ceiling: Cross-domain philosophy-of-science synthesis with a narrow operational proposal; no universality claim.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Scientific representation, model validation, second-order cybernetics, psychometrics, metamathematics, and philosophy of scientific practice.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Bounded application or calibration case before stronger general claims.

candidates.title: Metrology for Formal Structure: Calibration, Representation Invariance, and Experimental Analysis of Formal Systems
candidates.claim_ceiling: Methodological synthesis and proposed experimental discipline for formal representations.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Measurement theory, metrology, formal methods, experimental mathematics, reproducibility, and model validation.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Demonstration on finite inspectable formal systems.

candidates.title: When Does a Structural Property Become a Measurand?
candidates.claim_ceiling: Philosophical and methodological clarification; translation or synthesis is an acceptable outcome.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: High-priority measurement-theory and philosophy-of-measurement audit.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Examples and nonexamples of operationalized structural properties.

candidates.title: Accounting Closure Is Not System Closure: Representation, Remainder, and Consequence in Economic Accounts
candidates.claim_ceiling: Formal distinction and conceptual synthesis unless accounting literature establishes stronger novelty.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Accounting boundary and entity theory, externalities, social and environmental accounting, ecological economics, and measurement theory.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Worked accounting cases and counterexamples.

candidates.title: Retained Value as System Capacity: A Relational Account of Capture, Reserve, and Viability
candidates.claim_ceiling: Relational synthesis and constructed-model result before empirical calibration.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Liquidity, slack resources, resilience, ecological economics, stakeholder theory, welfare theory, and option value.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Case corpus or calibrated examples before policy claims.

candidates.title: Beyond Amount-Only Transactions: A Typed Model for Consequence, Burden, Standing, and Closure
candidates.artifact_state: explicit academic paper architecture with executable schema target
candidates.claim_ceiling: Representation and information-systems contribution; no claim that ordinary accounting cannot encode a distinction until audited.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Bookkeeping, managerial accounting, ESG and social accounting, ontology, information systems, and consequence accounting.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Worked ambiguous transactions and comparative representation study.

candidates.title: When Local Capture Degrades Global Viability: A Toy Model of Representationally Driven Extraction Feedback
candidates.claim_ceiling: Properties of the constructed toy model only until empirical calibration.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Political economy, extraction models, system dynamics, financial fragility, resilience, and maintenance economics.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Executable toy model first; empirical calibration can follow.

candidates.title: Pointer and Referent in Economic Governance: Representation, State, and Policy Transition
candidates.claim_ceiling: Computational political-economy framing and model architecture.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Economic state variables, stock-flow consistent modeling, institutional economics, public-policy modeling, cybernetics, and computational social science.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Worked examples plus comparison to established economic models.

candidates.title: Social-Lawful Structure: Boundaries Between Norm, Institution, and Enforceable Rule
candidates.claim_ceiling: Conceptual synthesis unless comparative legal and social evidence supports stronger claims.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Jurisprudence, sociology of law, institutional theory, norms, and enforcement.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Comparative cases or explicit non-empirical philosophy framing.

candidates.title: Economic Fabric and Concentration: Consequence Paths Under Institutional Consolidation
candidates.claim_ceiling: Conceptual or mechanism paper before empirical concentration claims.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Industrial organization, market concentration, economic sociology, institutional economics, and network resilience.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Empirical dataset or clearly bounded toy or case-study treatment.

candidates.title: Digital Governance and Agency Laundering: Responsibility Across Delegated Technical Systems
candidates.artifact_state: materialized thematic component / strong latent conceptual paper
candidates.claim_ceiling: Conceptual synthesis and responsibility taxonomy.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Algorithmic accountability, responsibility gaps, moral crumple zones, principal-agent theory, platform governance, and administrative law.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Case studies strongly preferred.

candidates.title: Anonymity, Privacy, and Provenance: A Boundary Problem in Accountable Systems
candidates.claim_ceiling: Philosophy-of-technology and governance synthesis.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Privacy theory, anonymity, provenance, accountability, data governance, and contextual integrity.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Case or protocol analysis.

candidates.title: Delegated Organizational Agency and Engineering to Failure
candidates.claim_ceiling: Organizational mechanism and ethics synthesis.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Organization theory, principal-agent theory, moral hazard, normalization of deviance, safety engineering, and business ethics.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Organizational cases or bounded model.

candidates.title: People, Value, and Institutions: Consequence as a Constraint on Organizational Valuation
candidates.claim_ceiling: Normative and institutional synthesis.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Business ethics, stakeholder theory, capabilities, institutional economics, and labor or value theory where relevant.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Choose normative philosophy or empirical institutional study before promotion.

candidates.title: Delegated Agency in Business-to-Business Systems: Responsibility Beyond the Contract Boundary
candidates.claim_ceiling: Organizational responsibility synthesis.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Principal-agent theory, fiduciary responsibility, outsourcing, supply-chain responsibility, moral outsourcing, and organizational accountability.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Case-study corpus preferred.

candidates.title: Can Independent Annotators Identify Consequential Boundaries and Responsibility Paths?
candidates.claim_ceiling: Empirical annotation-reliability result on a specified corpus.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Inter-rater reliability, qualitative coding, requirements engineering, responsibility modeling, HCI, and STS methods.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Predefined annotation protocol, independent annotators, agreement statistics, and adversarial cases.

candidates.title: Does Explicit Consequence Provenance Improve Defect Localization?
candidates.claim_ceiling: Bounded empirical result on a specified task and representation.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Debugging, provenance, traceability, causal explanation, requirements engineering, and HCI evaluation.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Controlled comparison with conventional traceability and debugging representations.

candidates.title: What Does a Behavioral Interface Forget?
candidates.claim_ceiling: Bounded socio-technical and interface analysis; established abstraction literature remains the baseline.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Abstraction, information hiding, APIs, contracts, affordances, HCI, requirements engineering, and socio-technical systems.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Worked interfaces and explicit consequence-loss examples.

candidates.title: Scientific Closure Is Regime-Relative: Provisional Warrant Under Declared Boundaries
candidates.claim_ceiling: Philosophy-of-science account of provisional closure under declared admissibility conditions.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Confirmation, scientific warrant, model adequacy, fallibilism, robustness, and philosophy of measurement.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Worked scientific cases showing closure without absolute truth claims.

candidates.title: The Represented State Space Is Not the Observed State Space: Correspondence as a Scientific Testing Problem
candidates.claim_ceiling: Philosophical synthesis and defect taxonomy unless stronger novelty survives primary-source comparison.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Measurement theory, model-based science, data-model distinctions, inverse problems, model discrepancy, misspecification, and observational equivalence.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Worked defect classes comparing model-admitted and empirically observable states or transitions.

candidates.title: Admissible Forgetting as a Scientific Operation: What May a Representation Omit Without Losing Consequence?
candidates.claim_ceiling: Scientific-representation synthesis; high overlap with Information Mechanics must be resolved first.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Scientific idealization, abstraction, coarse-graining, sufficient statistics, lossy representation, and model reduction.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Cases where omitted distinctions can and cannot be reconstructed without consequence loss.

candidates.title: Where Did the Scientific Error Enter? Representation Defects Across Observation, Model, and Claim
candidates.claim_ceiling: Diagnostic synthesis over scientific representation and error localization.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Measurement error, model misspecification, validation, epistemic risk, scientific workflows, and provenance.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Worked cases locating defects at boundary, observation, representation, transition, or claim layers.

candidates.title: AI as Forge: Alternating Breadth and Depth in Machine-Assisted Scientific Inquiry
candidates.artifact_state: materialized workflow note plus benchmark scaffold
candidates.claim_ceiling: Testable workflow contribution; no superiority claim before controlled benchmark.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Human-AI scientific discovery, literature-based discovery, search strategies, abduction, iterative deepening, research agents, scientific workflows, sensemaking, and counterexample-guided refinement.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Matched-budget benchmark against breadth-only, depth-only, and unconstrained research-agent conditions.

candidates.title: Provenance as an Epistemic Invariant in Machine-Assisted Research
candidates.claim_ceiling: Methodological and epistemic synthesis until controlled evidence shows operational benefit.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Scientific provenance, reproducibility, data lineage, audit trails, research agents, and epistemology of testimony.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Compare provenance-preserving and provenance-poor research workflows on auditability and reconstruction.

candidates.title: Failure as Evidence: Counterexamples, Failed Reductions, and Negative Results as First-Class Scientific State
candidates.claim_ceiling: Philosophy and workflow synthesis; failed reduction is evidence about the tested representation, not proof of ontology.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Falsification, negative results, counterexamples, replication, failed search, error analysis, and scientific workflow provenance.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Worked research traces where retained failure information improves subsequent diagnosis or narrowing.

candidates.title: Resolution Navigation: Context-Preserving Semantic Zoom in Typed Knowledge Interfaces
candidates.artifact_state: formal concept note plus HCI research scaffold
candidates.claim_ceiling: Bounded HCI result plus formal interaction model; no general superiority claim.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Semantic zoom, focus+context, overview+detail, progressive disclosure, graph navigation, hierarchical interfaces, spatial hypertext, and knowledge-graph interfaces.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Controlled comparison against zoomable graphs, hierarchy plus breadcrumbs, and overview-detail baselines.

candidates.title: Visible Partiality: Can Interfaces Disclose Filters and Omissions Without Destroying Usability?
candidates.artifact_state: HCI paper scaffold plus experiment contract
candidates.claim_ceiling: Bounded transparency/usability tradeoff; richer disclosure must beat simpler conventional filter-state UI.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Filter-state UI, uncertainty and provenance visualization, progressive disclosure, transparency, calibrated trust, and decision-support HCI.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Compare undisclosed filtering, compact conventional disclosure, structured disclosure, and interactive omission disclosure.

candidates.title: Reversible Depth: Context Recovery After Deep Navigation in Complex Information Spaces
candidates.claim_ceiling: Bounded navigation result on specified information spaces and tasks.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Breadcrumbs, navigation history, lost-in-hyperspace research, overview+detail, focus+context, and spatial memory.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Compare explicit ancestry and reversible-depth treatment against browser history, breadcrumbs, and overview-detail baselines.

candidates.title: Typed Resolution and Relation Confusion in Knowledge Graph Interfaces
candidates.claim_ceiling: Bounded relation-comprehension result for specified graph tasks.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Graph readability, edge labeling, knowledge-graph interfaces, semantic zoom, visual clutter, and relation comprehension.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Compare generic edges, always-visible typed edges, and typed-on-focus edges.

candidates.title: Invariant-Preserving Compression and Recall After Detail Exploration
candidates.claim_ceiling: Bounded memory and orientation result; no cognitive law claim.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Information visualization, summarization, overview+detail, cognitive maps, memory, and progressive disclosure.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Compare structured semantic compression against conventional zoom-out or overview return.

candidates.title: Resolution Paths as Reproducible Explanations in Interactive Knowledge Systems
candidates.claim_ceiling: Bounded explainability and reproducibility result for interactive exploration traces.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Interaction history, provenance visualization, explainable interfaces, sensemaking, and reproducible analytic workflows.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Test whether shareable resolution paths improve reconstruction and explanation quality against conventional history traces.

candidates.title: Reframing Without Losing the Object: Identity Persistence Across Coordinated System Views
candidates.claim_ceiling: Bounded coordinated-view identity result.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Coordinated multiple views, brushing and linking, object constancy, animation, information architecture, and visual analytics.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Compare identity-preserving reframe transitions against conventional coordinated-view navigation.

candidates.title: Accessibility Equivalence for Spatial and Semantic Navigation Interfaces
candidates.claim_ceiling: Accessibility equivalence result on specified tasks and modalities; no certification claim.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Accessible visualization, nonvisual navigation, keyboard interaction, reduced motion, screen readers, and multimodal equivalence.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Demonstrate semantically equivalent routes and compare task completion across spatial and non-spatial modalities.

candidates.title: When Is an Information Task Done? Closure Recognition in Open-Ended Exploratory Interfaces
candidates.claim_ceiling: Bounded exploratory-task result once closure recognition is independently operationalized.
candidates.prior_art_requirement: Exploratory search, information foraging, sensemaking, stopping rules, information scent, and task completion.
candidates.evidence_requirement: Operationalize closure recognition before testing interface support for it.

frontier.question: Does context-preserving semantic zoom improve orientation, relation comprehension, and return-path recovery in typed knowledge interfaces compared with conventional zoomable graphs and hierarchy plus breadcrumbs?
failure_outcomes: effect is narrow to one task or domain
frontier.claim_ceiling: Bounded HCI result plus formal interaction model; no general superiority claim.

frontier.question: Does alternating breadth-first comparison with depth-first reduction improve auditability, reconstruction quality, and defect discovery compared with breadth-only, depth-only, and unconstrained research-agent workflows?
failure_outcomes: provenance rather than alternation is the active ingredient
frontier.claim_ceiling: Testable workflow contribution; no superiority claim before controlled benchmark.

frontier.question: Can an interface disclose active filters, omissions, and projection boundaries in a way that improves calibration without unacceptable workload or performance cost?
failure_outcomes: simple filter chips fully subsume richer disclosure
frontier.claim_ceiling: Bounded transparency/usability tradeoff; prefer the least-complex disclosure that produces material benefit.

frontier.question: Do relation types revealed or differentiated under focus reduce false relational inference compared with generic edges and always-visible typed edges?
failure_outcomes: always-visible typing is equal or better
frontier.claim_ceiling: Bounded relation-comprehension result for specified graph tasks.

frontier.question: Does preserving ancestry, active context, and reversible depth improve recovery after deep exploration compared with conventional browser history and breadcrumbs?
failure_outcomes: effect only appears for unfamiliar domains
frontier.claim_ceiling: Bounded navigation result on specified information spaces and tasks.

frontier.question: What distinct scientific errors arise when a model-admitted state space mismatches the states or transitions observable in the target system?
failure_outcomes: existing discrepancy literature fully subsumes the taxonomy
state-space framing adds no diagnostic value
frontier.claim_ceiling: Philosophical synthesis and taxonomy unless stronger novelty survives prior-art review.
